title: Smart Water Tank IoT Monitoring Idea

messages.content: I was thinking about building a smart water tank monitoring system that measures the overhead tank water level and automatically turns the motor off when full.
That is a great IoT project idea! You can use an ultrasonic sensor (HC-SR04) or a float sensor connected to an ESP32 microcontroller with a relay module to control the water pump motor automatically.
What components would I need for the prototype, and how can I send mobile notifications?

For the prototype, you will need:
1. ESP32 microcontroller with Wi-Fi
2. Ultrasonic Distance Sensor
3. 5V Relay Module
4. Water pump motor (or LED indicator for testing)

For notifications, you can use the Blynk IoT platform or Firebase Cloud Messaging to send push notifications directly to your smartphone when the tank level reaches 90%.
